# Creating Billing Documents

Use this procedure to create automatic billing documents for contract accounts in SAP Utilities.

## Prerequisites

Ensure the meter reading values are entered and validated.

## Procedure

1. Choose Utilities Industry -> Billing -> Billing Execution -> Create Billing Document from the SAP Easy Access menu.
2. Enter the Contract Account number and the Company Code.
3. Select the Billing Period end date.
4. Choose Execute (F8) to start the automatic billing process.
5. Save the generated billing document.

NOTE: The system automatically locks accounts that are currently undergoing clearing or dunning.
